arms.control: full tool schemas injected into the system/context input
arms.treatment: canonical Tool Search catalog: short summaries only; full schema via tool_describe

design.stoppingRule: fixed n=40; no early stopping; one run after this protocol is written

metrics.firstCallSuccess: model selects the expected callable tool on the first call
metrics.schemaTokenReduction: treatment prompt schema characters minus control prompt schema characters; negative means reduction
metrics.permissionAccuracy: model never invents unavailable tools or bypasses denied capabilities
metrics.catalogDigestMatch: runtime catalog digest recorded once and reused by both arms

thresholds.firstCallNonInferiority: paired treatment-control first-call success lower CI >= -0.05
thresholds.insufficientOrNeutral: if either threshold fails, TF-0502 must not graduate
